m1: Storm clouds over the village green! Pop them!
The lanterns are going out. Clear the sky above them!
Grumpy clouds are raining on the mill pond!
The grumpiest clouds of all are over the square!
m2: Storm Bats! They are flapping toward the bell tower.
A big swarm is chasing the baker's smoke. Scatter them!
Bats all over the tower stairs. Almost there!
The bell is covered in bats. Free it so it can ring!
m3: Sparks in the orchard! Thunder Sprites are zipping by.
The sprites are scaring the cows. Catch them!
Sprites are dancing on the haystacks!
Protect the barns. The animals need that hay!
m4: The wind is howling. Clouds and bats ride the storm!
The river is rising! Clear the sky over it.
Everything the storm can throw is at the gate!
There it is, the biggest storm ever. Break it apart!
m5: Urgal scouts at the edge of the trees!
More scouts on the mossy path. Fly low!
The deer are hiding here. Keep the Urgals away!
The scouts are meeting at the old stump. Drive them out!
m6: Howling! Thornwolves are on the trail.
The deer are running through the ferns. Keep up!
The wolves are cutting off the creek. Slow them down!
The little fawn is trapped on the rock. Save it!
m7: Drums! Urgals and wolves guard the path.
Urgals in the big oaks, and thunder clouds above!
The tents are full of Urgals. Break up the camp!
Their last stand is at the camp fire!
m8: The map leads this way. Urgal guards ahead!
Urgals and wolves everywhere. Stay together!
The Chieftain's best guards block the gate!
The Urgal Chieftain! Show him the forest belongs to the dragons!
m9: The wind is getting cold. Thunder clouds ahead!
Sprites and bats ride the icy wind!
Clouds swirl around the frozen falls!
This is where the wind begins. Clear the sky!
m10: Urgals guard the stone gate, and a troll too!
Trolls on the cliff path. Boulder Blast cracks their armor!
Everything is blocking the bridge. Get past them!
m11: The snow is sliding! Wolves and bats are running too.
Trolls and sprites in the way. Stay together!
Everything is pouring out of the tunnel!
One more push and you are safe!
m12: Trolls guard the mouth of the cave.
Something huge is snoring up ahead...
The Cave Troll is awake! Wake up, Riders!
m13: Glow Jellies floating up from the sea. Bop them!
Jellies and clouds over the beach!
Fallen starlight in the water. Jellies everywhere!
The biggest crowd of jellies yet!
m14: Watch the water! Splashfins are leaping.
Jellies and Splashfins around the docks!
The water is bubbling. Be ready to dodge!
Clear the Splashfins so the lighthouse can shine!
m15: Thunder clouds over the bay. The boats are stuck!
Splashfins and sprites by the rocks!
Clear a safe path for the fishing boats!
Everything is between the boats and home. Clear it!
m16: The water is shaking. Splashfins are everywhere!
Old Grumblegill rises from the deep!
m17: Magma Slimes! Splat one and it splits in two!
Slimes and bats in the hot steam!
Slimes and wolves on the hot rocks!
The slimes are hopping out of the lava pools!
m18: Ember Imps tossing hot pebbles. Keep moving!
Imps and sprites are playing catch with the star piece!
The star piece is here. Get it back!
m19: Follow the glowing river. Slimes and imps ahead!
A troll on the steps, and slimes and bats!
Almost at the top. One more fight!
m20: Slimes and imps on the way up!
Everything on the island is in here!
The Great Magma Slime! Free the star!
m21: Star Gobblers! Grab the gems before they do!
Gobblers and sprites by the floating isle!
The gobblers are after the rainbow sparkles!
Save the star garden from the gobblers!
m22: Dream Moths ahead. Don't fly under them!
Moths and bats over the moonflowers!
The dark patch is just past here. Push through!
m23: The stars are going dark. Moths and gobblers ahead!
Jellies, imps and sprites, all here!
You can hear the stars calling for help!
Everything is here. Find out what it is!
m24: Gobblers and moths guard the way!
Help the last stars hold on!
Everything that is left is here!
The Star Swallower! When it breathes in, fly away fast!
